jobs.title: Director, Real Estate Asset Management
jobs.description:
About Realty Income

Realty Income (NYSE: O), an S&P 500 company, is a real estate partner to the world's leading companies. Founded in 1969, we invest in diversified commercial real estate and have a portfolio of 15,600 properties in all 50 U.S. states, the UK and six other countries in Europe, with a gross book value $58bn. We are known as "The Monthly Dividend Company®” and have a mission to deliver stockholders dependable monthly dividends that grow over time. Since our founding, we have declared 656 consecutive monthly dividends and are a member of the S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats® index, having increased our dividend for the last 30 consecutive years.

You will be joining one of the largest Real Estate Investment Trusts in the world as we rapidly expand into the UK and European markets, including moving into new offices at 3 St. James’s Square.
The European portfolio, including the UK, has experienced consistent growth quarter-on-quarter since our first international acquisition, a £429m 12-property portfolio from Sainsbury’s in 2019. In just five years the portfolio now includes investments of over $11bn, and 483 distinct properties.

As we accelerate our expansion into the UK and European markets, the company is making significant investments in infrastructure and talent. Moving into new offices at 3 St. James’s Square signals the next phase of growth and commitment to the region. You will be joining the UK market leader in asset management, working with the most prestige retail clients. You will be managing a growing portfolio c.$3bn with new assets being added, you will be able to assist with the development of the team and able to build enhanced client relationships and negotiation capabilities across a diverse UK and potential EU portfolio. This environment offers exceptional opportunities for professional development and career advancement as both the company and its portfolio continue to expand.

Position Overview:

The Director, Asset Management, UK (Director) partners closely with the Head of Asset Management and Value-Add Investment, UK, the broader asset management team, company leadership, and clients (i.e. tenants) to drive asset management strategies and outcomes, including enhancing tenancy, income, occupancy, and green initiatives across Realty Income’s industry-leading UK portfolio (~$10B today) that continues to grow quickly. The Director’s role is highly communicative and collaborative across multiple touchpoints daily, with departments across Realty Income and with many external clients, advisors, and vendors. The Director drives win-win relationships with our clients, deepening and broadening existing relationships while cultivating new ones.

Key Responsibilities:
- Direct responsibility for delivering returns on a diverse UK portfolio
- Direct responsibility for managing client relationships, including top 10 clients
- Co-ordinate the Annual Business Planning Process for assets
- Coordinate Annual Budgeting and Forecasting
- Lead major portfolio discussions/deals – including analysis and presentations
- Drive Client Service Team across multiple clients
- Direct ESG Initiatives across the portfolio – including EV car charging, solar projects, SMART initiatives, and local community initiatives
- Carry out lease renewals, rent reviews, lease regears, new lettings (including internal analysis and presentations, negotiating with clients, and working with Legal to transact deals) and keep the Head of AM & VA apprised of such activities
- Manage monthly leasing meetings with leasing agents, planners, project managers, and property managers
- Identify additive revenue opportunities through developments and commercialisation opportunities
- Oversee (inc. managing planners, development / project managers, highways consultants, etc.) developments at our existing sites such as amalgamation works, existing tenant upsize & downsize projects, extensions, new units, drive-thru units
- Meet regularly with local stakeholders of our assets and foster strong relationships (council representatives, adjacent owners, etc.)
- Provide support to Value-Add transactions (for new purchases) where detailed business plans are required
- Visits and meetings with retail clients to develop and enhance relationships, obtain company and real estate information concerning Clients’ future plans and needs
- Validate and reconcile metrics for quarterly reporting requirements
- Delegate tasks to analysts relating to research, review, analysis, evaluation, and preparation for negotiations and presentations
- Review analysts’ work product and prepared materials (research, analysis, map packages, transaction memos, Client information, etc.).
- Manage analysts and provide clear direction
- Identify adjacent ownerships that can be acquired that will enhance the returns of our existing assets and liaise with the Investment Team

Organisational Relationships :
- Interfaces across the organisation and with multiple external stakeholders.
- Internal contacts: - The Director must maintain productive relationships with numerous internal constituencies, including senior executives, Acquisitions, Asset Management, Capital Markets, Lease Administration, Portfolio Analytics, Predictive Analytics, Legal, Property Management, Research, Strategy, Development, and the Investment Committee.

- External contacts: - The Director must maintain productive relationships with numerous external constituencies, including real estate brokers, corporate client contacts, and third-party requestors.

Candidate Requirements
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Must have for the role:
- Extensive relevant real estate asset management experience across the retail warehouse and/or logistics sectors.
- Significant prior financial responsibility or accountability
- Experience across the disciplines of leasing, rent review & lease renewals, investment, development, valuation
- Thorough knowledge of commercial real estate principles; couple with strong technical analysis and IT skillsets including intermediate to advanced excel.
- Capability to manage people and resources effectively.
- Strong negotiating skills with the ability to impart salesmanship, be persuasive, and overcome objections.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills; including the ability to present proposals, negotiate transactions and convey complex ideas, concepts, and recommendations to senior management.
- Ability to manage disagreements and point-of-view differences with Clients, Client-hired lease negotiators, Buyers, and other third-party requestors.
- Aptitude and ability to make effective decisions and present recommendations.
- Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced business environment and prioritise competing job demands.
- Ability to manage disagreements and point-of-view differences with Clients, Client-hired lease advisors, Buyers, and other third-party requestors.
- Strong critical-thinking abilities and innovative approach to the role.
- Aptitude and ability to make effective decisions and present recommendations.
- Establish, maintain and grow cooperative working relationships both internally and externally.
- Ability for occasional business travel required.

Desirable but not essential:
- 1st class honours Undergraduate degree

Our Mission & Values

For more than 50 years, Realty Income has been guided by our mission to invest in people and places to deliver dependable monthly dividends that increase over time. We do this by nurturing long-term, meaningful relationships that enable people to achieve a better financial outlook. We understand that when individuals succeed financially, they are able to provide for their families, support local businesses and pursue their greatest ambitions, creating a lasting positive impact on communities.

Realty Income is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes all applicants regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or educational background.

About Realty Income

Realty Income (NYSE: O), an S&P 500 company, is a real estate partner to the world's leading companies. Founded in 1969, we invest in diversified commercial real estate and have a portfolio of 15,600 properties in all 50 U.S. states, the UK and six other countries in Europe, with a gross book value $58bn. We are known as "The Monthly Dividend Company®” and have a mission to deliver stockholders dependable monthly dividends that grow over time. Since our founding, we have declared 656 consecutive monthly dividends and are a member of the S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats® index, having increased our dividend for the last 30 consecutive years.

Those joining the real estate development team at Realty Income are stepping in at an exciting stage, with direct accountability over segments of an extensive and evolving portfolio. Team members manage a diverse array of projects; including non-standard developments, ground-up construction, and other dynamic initiatives. This environment offers exceptional opportunities for professional development and career advancement as both the company and its portfolio continue to expand.

Position Overview:

The Senior Development Manager (SDM) will support the Development Director (DD) with the successful delivery of projects across a wide-ranging £10bn+ International portfolio, including retail & industrial projects. The Senior Development Manager will be responsible for appointing the design team, securing planning permissions, and procuring and delivering projects from start to finish. The Senior Development Manager has a highly collaborative role with multiple touchpoints daily with departments across Realty Income and with many external clients, advisors, and stakeholders. This role supports the Development Director in the growth of a new capability within an established and rapidly growing business.

Key Responsibilities:
- Coordinate a proportion of the development pipeline across the international portfolio and is responsible for delivering all capital expenditure initiatives determined by the DD and relevant Asset Managers including ground up developments, amalgamations, upsizes, downsizes, and maintenance, with regular reporting to the Development Director on progress, commercial performance, key risks, and issues.
- Collaborate with the US Construction and Procurement Team on all CapEx projects (including maintenance) regarding internal procedures, reporting, drawdowns, etc...
- Collaborate with the Property Management Team on maintenance and CapEx initiatives across the portfolio.
- Manage all pre-contract activities in the development process, including leading the planning application and procurement processes.
- Support the Development Director in all CDM, Health & Safety, and statutory regulatory approval processes for all international construction activities, including appointment of consultants where required.
- Agree with the Development Director on the appointment of consultant project teams and manage coordination across the international portfolio on all allocated projects.
- Ensure all allocated projects are procured using the most appropriate forms of construction contract and procurement methodology to ensure the most efficient commercial delivery across the portfolio.
- The Senior Development Manager is required to visit assets regularly across the UK and Ireland.
- Act collaboratively with the Asset Management Team on development feasibility opportunities.
- Provide input into development appraisals, acquisitions, and other repositioning strategies for the asset management and investment teams.
- Develop client briefs on construction projects across the portfolio and ensure that all works are delivered to agreed project outcomes.
- Maintain and manage reporting processes across the portfolio and multiple consultant teams.
- Assist the Development Director in reviewing, approving, and processing project invoices alongside the finance team.

Collaboration & Relationships :
Internal Contacts:
- Collaborate and communicate with the Asset Management department to ensure an organised approach, transparency of workflow, and pursuit of the optimum solution for a given property; Provide projections that are to be incorporated into their reporting.
- Collaborate and communicate with the Development Team and Construction & Procurement Team in the US to ensure alignment of approach and regular reporting.
- Collaborate with and provide information/direction to the accounting department, including budget forecasting, job cost allocation, and issue resolution.
- Present to the Investment Committee as required.
- Provide information to the Legal department, including Attorneys and Paralegals; Work in concert to assess risk, provide solutions, and complete transactions.
- Work with Sustainability to employ environmentally friendly initiatives in development.
- Communicate with Lease Administration and Real Estate Operations to ensure a seamless flow of information throughout the development process.

External Contacts:
- Create and maintain relationships with third-party support, tenants, real estate developers, and brokers; Help negotiate agreements for leases and specifications, leases, development agreements, commission agreements, third-party documents, etc.; oversee, inform, and direct throughout the development process.
- Engage, advise, and negotiate with government entities, planners, and other specialists.
- Performs other duties as assigned.

Candidate Requirements
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Must have for the role:
- Suitable commercial retail real estate-related experience gained at an established landlord or development consultancy; with extensive retail development experience (including extensions, amalgamations, downsizes, facade replacements), refurbishment, new development projects, and asset repositioning projects.
- While we do not set upper or lower limits of years’ experience for our vacancies, candidates with at least 8-10+ years’ Commercial Real Estate Development experience is likely to have the right level of knowledge and experience for this role; strong candidates outside of this range will be considered.
- Experience in leading consultant and project teams on multiple projects & programmes at any one time.
- Either consultancy or client organisation experience for delivery of capital projects across the UK and Europe.
- Must have substantial knowledge of the JCT & SBC forms of contract and be able to guide & advise on contract selection and implement suitable contract amendments.
- Experienced in the negotiation of legal planning agreements.
- Experience in reviewing and critiquing an agreement for leases, technical negotiations, and development of landlord shell specifications.

- Chartered Surveyor (MRICS) qualified.
- Solid analytical, problem-solving, and financial analysis and IT skills (Inc. Excel and Word).
- Excellent professional communication skills both verbal and written, able to establish and maintain effective working relationships.
- Exceptional problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively identify issues, research and analyse complicated matters, assess potential exposure and minimise risk, propose alternative courses of action, and make well-reasoned recommendations.

Desirable but not essential:
- Industrial and logistics development experience, including large single-box development and multi-unit development projects.
- Undergraduate degree: BSc or BA in related field (or equivalent work experience).

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Retail Asset Management and Leasing
jobs.description:
Realty Income aims to be a globally recognized leader in the S&P 100, committed to creating long-term value for all stakeholders. These stakeholders include our dedicated team members, who embody our purpose: building enduring relationships and brighter financial futures. This guiding principle serves as a beacon for our team, influencing every action we take.

Our employees consistently invest their time, commitment, and dedication into the company, and in turn, they receive investment returns in the form of purpose, belonging, and opportunities for advancement.

We are committed to best-in-class corporate responsibility practices through environmental initiatives, governance programs, and community outreach projects. From the boardroom to the breakroom, our team members make a difference every day.

Position Overview

Realty Income is seeking a Senior Analyst, Retail Asset Management and Leasing to support portfolio strategy and transaction execution across our retail properties and client relationships. This role evaluates lease renewals, amendments, assignments, subleases, ancillary revenue opportunities, capital requests, and property dispositions. The Senior Analyst independently develops financial, client-credit, property, and market analyses; translates findings into clear recommendations; manages defined transaction workstreams; and supports commercial negotiations under the direction of an Asset Manager. This opportunity is well suited to an experienced real estate professional who combines strong analytical judgment with disciplined execution and confident communication across senior and cross-functional stakeholders.

Responsibilities

- Analyze properties, leases, client performance, store-level profitability, credit considerations, market conditions, and portfolio factors to support strategies that preserve and enhance value.

- Evaluate lease renewals, assignments, subleases, amendments, early terminations, capital requests, and other negotiated client matters.

- Conduct property, market, and competitive research to compare renewal, re-leasing, repositioning, and disposition alternatives.

- Build and   maintain   transparent financial models and perform   cash-flow , net present value, internal rate of return, lease-economics, valuation, and sensitivity analyses.

- Validate analytical inputs and clearly document assumptions, methodologies, data sources, sensitivities, information gaps, risks, and value opportunities.

- Develop concise, decision-ready recommendations and financial exhibits for Asset Management leadership, senior management, and Investment Committee review, as   appropriate .

- Manage assigned analytical and   execution   workstreams for lease transactions, ancillary revenue opportunities, and selected dispositions.

- Support the development and review of letters of intent, business terms,   approval   materials, and transaction documentation.

- Participate in discussions and negotiations with clients, brokers, and counterparties with guidance from the assigned Asset Manager.

- Track open issues, approvals, dependencies, documentation, economics, timing, probability, and next steps through transaction completion.

- Escalate material risks, unresolved issues, and changes in transaction economics with a recommended path forward.

- Coordinate with Legal, Property Management, Lease Administration, Predictive Analytics, Research, Acquisitions, Development, Finance and Accounting, and other partners.

- Help ensure approved business terms are accurately reflected in transaction documents and internal systems.

- Evaluate cell tower, billboard, and other third-party ancillary revenue opportunities and support associated commercial discussions and execution.

- Assist   with selected property dispositions, including valuation, market analysis, broker input, due diligence, alternatives, and expected financial outcomes.

- Present analytical findings and recommendations clearly and build productive relationships with clients, brokers, consultants, appraisers, buyers, and internal partners.

Qualifications

We would typically expect the successful candidate to have:

- 2+ years of relevant experience in commercial real estate asset management, leasing, acquisitions, dispositions, development, investment analysis, real estate finance, corporate real estate, investment banking, or   a related   field.

- Bachelor's degree in real estate, finance, economics, accounting, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

- Demonstrated experience building or reviewing real estate financial models.

- Working knowledge of cash-flow analysis, valuation, net present value, internal rate of return, lease economics, and sensitivity analysis.

- Ability to analyze financial statements, client credit, lease economics, property information, market data, and transaction alternatives.

- Experience preparing clear written recommendations, presentations, and financial exhibits for business decisions.

- Advanced   proficiency   in Microsoft Excel and strong   proficiency   in PowerPoint and Word.

- Strong written, verbal, organizational, and interpersonal communication skills .

- Ability to manage multiple assignments, set priorities, meet deadlines,   maintain   accurate   records, and escalate material issues.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with retail, net lease, sale-leaseback, or corporate real estate portfolios.

- Exposure to lease renewals, amendments, assignments, subleases, early terminations, or lease restructuring.

- Experience supporting negotiations with clients, brokers, landlords, or other transaction counterparties.

- Familiarity with letters of intent, lease agreements, reciprocal easement agreements, CC&Rs, surveys, and site plans.

- Experience preparing materials for senior management, an Investment Committee, or another formal approval body.

- Exposure to   investment sales, ancillary revenue arrangements, or property-level capital decisions.

Certifications

- California Department of Real Estate Salesperson license preferred.

This position is based in our San Diego (Del Mar Heights) headquarters. Monday through Thursday are in-office for collaboration, with the opportunity to work remotely on Friday. For candidates outside San Diego and it's surrounding counties, remote working options may be available.

The salary range for this role is $68,021 - $84,004 - $102,339.

Offers near the high end are uncommon but may be considered for candidates with exceptional experience and skills and are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. You may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus and an annual discretionary stock award, to be discussed during the interview process. An annual pay rate and total compensation package is generally determined by the candidate's experience, knowledge, education, skills, performance, and abilities, as well as internal equity, company performance, and alignment with market data.

We offer a best-in-class benefits package that includes healthcare, dental, and vision insurance for employees and eligible dependents. Our 401(k)-retirement plan has a company match of 50% up to 6% of eligible compensation. Realty Income also offers other wellness, financial, and work/lifestyle-specific benefits, along with a generous PTO accrual; in addition to 12 paid holidays, and paid volunteer time. Realty Income’s purpose is to build enduring relationships and brighter financial futures, and this starts with you!

This role is subject to enhanced compliance and disclosure requirements comparable with those of a regulated financial services organization, including conflict of interest disclosures and personal trading policies.

Realty Income is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you require accessibility support to submit your application or other reasonable accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please contact talent@realtyincome.com, or call 800-375-6700. An employee will respond to your message to begin the interactive process. Please note that this phone number and email address are only for individuals seeking a disability accommodation when applying for a job.

jobs.title: Director/AVP, HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Realty Income aims to be a globally recognized leader in the S&P 100, committed to creating long-term value for all stakeholders. These stakeholders include our dedicated team members, who embody our purpose: building enduring relationships and brighter financial futures. This guiding principle serves as a beacon for our team, influencing every action we take.

Our employees consistently invest their time, commitment, and dedication into the company, and in turn, they receive investment returns in the form of purpose, belonging, and opportunities for advancement.

We are committed to best-in-class corporate responsibility practices through environmental initiatives, governance programs, and community outreach projects. From the boardroom to the breakroom, our team members make a difference every day.

Position Summary:

The People Success Business Partner will think strategically, execute tactically, and collaborate across many team levels and situations to enable company growth by partnering with business leaders to develop and execute People Success (HR) initiatives focusing on organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, employee engagement, Inclusion & Belonging, and more. In addition, this role will own programs that run across the organization. The role will build value through an embedded approach, a deep understanding of business priorities, and a proactive stance toward talent management. The purpose of this role is to strengthen Realty Income's ability to attract, engage, motivate, and retain top talent by optimizing each employee's potential.

This position may be hired at either the Director, People Success Partner or AVP, People Success Partner level based on the selected candidate's experience, demonstrated business impact, leadership capabilities, and scope of responsibility. Both levels serve as trusted business partners. Candidates hired at the AVP level will be expected to operate with broader enterprise influence, provide strategic counsel to executives, and lead complex cross-functional People Success initiatives.

This position is based in our San Diego (Del Mar area) headquarters. Monday through Thursday is in-office for collaboration, with the opportunity to work remotely on Friday.

Job Responsibilities:

Organizational Effectiveness
- Participate in developing and executing the company's HR strategy.

- Build and iterate parts of the Corporate Talent System so that employee learning, development, succession, and culture drive productivity, engagement, and performance.

- Partner with business leaders  on departmental employee engagement survey analysis, results communication, and action-planning initiatives.

- Inform and guide department leaders on team effectiveness, based upon situational awareness of the nuances of each sub-team.

- Assist in the design and structure of departments, business units, organizations, and jobs to optimize organizational design and effectiveness.

- Lead organizational change initiatives by leveraging proven change management strategies that accelerate adoption, build engagement, and help employees successfully navigate transformation.

- AVP scope: Play a larger role in shaping enterprise-wide workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, and talent strategies, including leading larger-scale organizational design initiatives that affect multiple functions or business units.

Internal Consulting Domain
- Provide coaching and mentoring to senior leaders, emerging leaders, and employees when the situation requires.

- Proactively diagnose organizational needs and root causes through data-driven analysis and stakeholder engagement, translating insights into impactful business solutions

- Bring in the right internal or external resources to ensure organizational needs are addressed while working through conflicting priorities.

- Establish credibility throughout the organization.

- Be an effective listener and solution-finder for people issues.

- Continually assess the competitiveness of programs and practices against relevant comparable companies, industries, and markets.

- AVP scope: Regularly serve as a strategic advisor to executives and senior leadership teams on complex organizational, leadership, and talent matters with broader enterprise impact.

HR Expertise
- Resolve employee issues while ensuring Realty Income remains compliant, mitigates risk.

- In Partnership with the Talent Acquisition team, lead Strategic Workforce Planning initiatives to ensure , and has the right number and type of talent to meet current and emerging needs.

- Co-create and launch initiatives focused on building a culture of inclusion that supports engagement and retention strategies.

- Leverage and analyze internal and external data to inform decision-making.

- Measure, track, and analyze the effectiveness of inclusion initiatives and anticipate future trends in inclusion efforts.

- Build and continually develop business and industry knowledge to enable effective budgetary spending and inform business decisions.

- Help deliver, execute, and measure leadership and management development programs from frontline leaders through Department Heads and executives.

- Partner with the VP, People Success, Talent Development, and Department Heads to manage succession, talent slates, and readiness for roles across the organization.

- Proactively identify, track, and recommend talent to fill key vacancies and support long-term growth strategies using available systems and tools.

- AVP scope: Provide greater leadership in shaping enterprise-wide succession, workforce, and talent strategies and lead complex People Success initiatives that span multiple functions or business units.

Qualifications:
- Director level: Minimum 8+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including experience supporting business leaders, leading employee relations matters, workplace investigations, organizational effectiveness efforts, and talent initiatives.

- AVP level: Minimum 10+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including experience leading complex company-wide HR initiatives, workforce planning, succession planning, organizational design, and advising senior leaders and executives.

- Significant experience in an HR Business Partner role, including work leading employee relations issues and investigations.

- Minimum of five years of coaching experience.

- Bachelor's degree required; MBA or Master's degree in Human Resources or a related field preferred.

- Strong employment law knowledge.

- Knowledge of leadership development and management training needs, with an ability to apply adult learning theories to employee programs.

- Ability to think and act holistically to help create differentiated value for business leaders and internal customers.

- Experience partnering on complex company-wide HR initiatives.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to draft legally sound communications.

- Strong presentation abilities, including the ability to communicate complex ideas to large groups, Department Heads, and senior leaders.

- Demonstrated ability to build broad-based relationships and trust across diverse constituencies.

- Desire to thrive in a high-accountability environment.

- Experience leading the creation or update of legal documents, such as employee handbooks and policies, preferred.

- Experience supporting international business units preferred.

Certificates, Licenses, or Registrations
- SPHR, California, or other senior HR certification.

- ACC, PCC, or MCC credential preferred.

AVP, People Success Partner base salary range: $142,831 - $188,855 - $252,389

jobs.title: Learning & Development Program Manager
jobs.description:
Realty Income aims to be a globally recognized leader in the S&P 100, committed to creating long-term value for all stakeholders. These stakeholders include our dedicated team members, who embody our purpose: building enduring relationships and brighter financial futures. This guiding principle serves as a beacon for our team, influencing every action we take.

Our employees consistently invest their time, commitment, and dedication into the company, and in turn, they receive investment returns in the form of purpose, belonging, and opportunities for advancement.

We are committed to best-in-class corporate responsibility practices through environmental initiatives, governance programs, and community outreach projects. From the boardroom to the breakroom, our team members make a difference every day.

Realty Income is hiring a Learning and Development Program Manager to join our People Succes Team. In this role, you will be responsible for the planning, delivery, measurement, and continuous improvement of a portfolio of leadership and employee development programs at Realty Income. This role manages the end-to-end administration and ongoing enhancement of the Senior Leader Development Program (SLDP), Leadership Advanced, and Leadership Essentials programs, including program planning, nomination processes, scheduling, participant and stakeholder communications and engagement, materials management, survey administration, effectiveness measurement, budgeting, vendor management, and related talent development initiatives.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of managing corporate learning programs in a complex business environment. They are highly organized, collaborative, data-informed, and skilled at translating talent and learning priorities into practical, engaging, and measurable learning experiences. This role may also manage other projects and programs as assigned that support talent development, leadership capability, and organizational effectiveness at Realty Income.

What You Will Be Working On:
- Manage leadership and employee development programs: Manage the annual planning, operating cadence, and execution of assigned leadership and employee development programs, ensuring effective delivery and alignment with established business needs, leadership expectations, and People Success priorities.
- Maintain and enhance program content: Maintain and improve program curricula, facilitator guides, participant materials, communications, assignments, pre-work, and post-work in partnership with Talent Development, internal stakeholders, and external vendors as business needs evolve.
- Coordinate program logistics and scheduling: Own program calendars, cohort schedules, session planning, room or virtual logistics, calendar invitations, facilitator coordination, materials preparation, attendance tracking, and participant follow-up.
- Lead the nominations and cohort management process: Manage nomination timelines, communications, eligibility guidance, stakeholder and People Success Partner input, participant confirmations, and cohort records to support a clear and equitable process.
- Manage communications and stakeholder engagement: Draft and execute participant, manager, executive sponsor, facilitator, and vendor communications that drive awareness, readiness, participation, and accountability.
- Measure learning effectiveness: Administer surveys and other evaluation tools; measure program effectiveness using the Kirkpatrick Model where appropriate, including participant reaction, learning, behavior/application, and business impact indicators. Monitor participation, engagement, and development trends to identify opportunities for improvement.
- Analyze data and report insights: Track participation, completion, engagement, survey feedback, and program outcomes; prepare dashboards, summaries, and recommendations to demonstrate impact and identify improvement opportunities.
- Manage program budget and vendors: Support budget planning, monitor program expenses, coordinate invoices and purchase processes, manage vendor relationships, and ensure external partners deliver high-quality work aligned to program objectives.
- Facilitate employee learning communities and knowledge sharing : Coordinate and facilitate internal learning opportunities (Learning Exchanges and Connections), peer learning forums, and other development experiences that encourage knowledge sharing, cross-functional collaboration, and employee growth.
- Develop employee learning resources: Develop and maintain learning resources, guides, toolkits, and development materials that support employee growth, leadership effectiveness, and knowledge sharing across the organization.
- Support learning technology, reporting, and administration : Maintain learning records, assignments, reporting, and other learning administration activities within Workday and/or other related learning platforms; identify opportunities to improve the learner experience, reporting capabilities and operational efficiency.
- Partner across People Success and the business: Collaborate with People Success Partners, Talent Development, executives, people leaders, and subject matter experts to identify development needs, learning opportunities, capability gaps, support leader readiness, promote employee growth, and connect learning initiatives to broader talent priorities.
- Drive continuous improvement: Evaluate participant and stakeholder feedback, identify process enhancements, improve the participant experience, and simplify repeatable program workflows.
- Support talent development projects: Lead or contribute to additional talent development, leadership capability, employee development, engagement, performance, or organizational effectiveness projects and programs as assigned.
- Protect data and confidentiality: Maintain accurate records and handle participant, nomination, survey, and talent-related information with appropriate confidentiality, care, and alignment to company policies.

What You Need To Be Successful:
- We expect at least five years of progressive experience in corporate learning and development, talent development, organizational development, leadership development, or related HR program management.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description:
Realty Income aims to be a globally recognized leader in the S&P 100, committed to creating long-term value for all stakeholders. These stakeholders include our dedicated team members, who embody our purpose: building enduring relationships and brighter financial futures. This guiding principle serves as a beacon for our team, influencing every action we take.

Our employees consistently invest their time, commitment, and dedication into the company, and in turn, they receive investment returns in the form of purpose, belonging, and opportunities for advancement.

We are committed to best-in-class corporate responsibility practices through environmental initiatives, governance programs, and community outreach projects. From the boardroom to the breakroom, our team members make a difference every day.

Realty Income is seeking a strategic Senior Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis to drive and enhance the company’s global financial planning and strategic analysis. This highly visible role will maintain and enhance the global corporate earnings model and translate complex scenario analysis into actionable recommendations for senior management. Additionally, they will support forecasting and budgeting.

The ideal candidate will have the desire to take on a unique opportunity that spans responsibility across the finance function with the opportunity to inform executive level decisions.  This role requires exceptional modeling capability, careful attention to detail, strong collaboration across domestic and international stakeholders, and the executive presence to communicate with senior leaders and public-company stakeholders.

What You Will Work On:
·         Oversee the corporate earnings guidance model in partnership with key departments, producing accurate and insightful forecasts.
·         Drive the consolidated quarterly corporate reforecast and support corporate earnings reporting and updates to the annual guidance outlook.
·         Track monthly variances against the corporate forecast and provide actionable insights to department heads and senior management.
·         Maintain, update, and enhance forecasting and reporting templates, including their integration into the corporate earnings model.
·         Develop monthly consolidated actual-to-budget comparisons and present key findings to senior management.
·         Lead quarterly analysis of key business operating and financial trends and communicate implications to senior management.
·         Lead and oversee the company’s consolidated annual budgeting process, coordinating across business functions to ensure a comprehensive, accurate, and timely enterprise-wide budget.
·         Partner weekly with department heads and finance team across domestic and international operations to maintain a rolling corporate reforecast, analyze initiatives, and report progress.
·         Support quarterly earnings preparation by providing insights to Investor Relations and senior management and helping ensure the accuracy of key financial reports.
·         Oversee Finance team reporting and analysis for the Realty Income Board of Directors.
·         Own periodic liquidity and covenant projections for commercial lending partners and credit rating agencies, including ad hoc data requests and questionnaires.
·         Streamline internal processes, strengthen internal controls, and evaluate software solutions for finance and accounting.

What You Need To be Successful:

We would expect the successful candidate to have:
·         Superior financial modeling, Excel, and PowerPoint skills.
·         A consistent commitment to strong performance, results, intellectual curiosity, and a high standard of accuracy.
·         Ability to lead through ambiguity, take initiative without explicit instruction, and meet public-company reporting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
·         Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex ideas to large groups and senior management.
·         Strong financial acumen and familiarity with global public-company financial statements and modeling.
·         Clear understanding of U.S. GAAP, SEC, and SOX requirements.
·         A technology- and AI-led mindset with the judgment to improve core planning, analysis, and reporting responsibilities.
·         Advanced ability to interpret technical, financial, and legal documents and present information to executive management and public-company stakeholders.
·         Advanced quantitative and reasoning skills, including algebra, time value of money, and earnings-per-share analysis.
·         5-7+ years of experience in industry, investment banking, or a public accounting firm, preferably including REIT industry experience.
·         BS in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a similar analytical field.

Preferred Qualifications:
·         Experience with financial software and accounting systems, particularly Adaptive Insights and Yardi.
·         REIT industry experience.
·         Demonstrated success improving forecasting, reporting, or finance processes through technology and AI-enabled solutions.
·         Experience preparing executive, Board, earnings, liquidity, covenant, or rating-agency materials.

Certifications:
·         CFA and/or CPA considered a plus.

Realty Income is seeking a Manager, Finance Operations Automation to own and advance the customer payment experience and cash application automation capabilities within the Invoice-to-Cash value stream. Reporting to the VP, Finance Operations, this leader will work at the intersection of Finance Operations, Technology, Data, Accounting, and Client Experience to improve how customers pay and how payments are matched, applied, controlled, and reported.

The role will serve as the functional owner of the cash application automation domain, leading strategy, implementation, governance, and continuous improvement across payment portals, ACH and wire enablement, banking instructions, remittance processing, matching logic, exception management, ERP capabilities, and supporting platforms.

Responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end customer payment strategy across portal, ACH, and wire channels, with accountability for consistent, scalable, and low-friction payment experiences.
- Govern banking instruction processes, including onboarding, validation, change management, controls, and auditability.
- Oversee customer statements, portal payments, dunning workflows, and alignment between customer communications and downstream cash application processes.
- Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of cash application automation, including remittance ingestion, matching logic, posting strategies, tolerance rules, confidence thresholds, and exception handling.
- Define scalable frameworks that connect payments, remittance data, customer accounts, and open receivables across entities and systems.
- Partner with Finance leadership and Accounting to balance automation efficiency, posting accuracy, financial controls, and audit requirements.
- Apply AI, advanced analytics, and data-driven processing techniques to improve payment matching, remittance association, and straight-through processing.
- Partner with Technology and Data teams to design scalable, governed, integrated, and auditable solutions.
- Evaluate technology and vendor options; develop business cases, translate business needs into requirements, and support integration, implementation, testing, and adoption.
- Act as the primary liaison across Finance Operations, Accounts Receivable, Accounting, Technology, Data, Client Experience, and Business Analyst teams for cash automation initiatives.
- Identify repeatable exception patterns and convert them into automation opportunities, rules, product enhancements, or process changes.
- Own and prioritize the cash automation backlog based on customer impact, control risk, operational effort, scalability, and measurable value.
- Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications and coordinate communication, UAT, implementation readiness, and post-launch improvement.
- Own the cash application technology ecosystem, including ERP and supporting payment, banking, remittance, reporting, and workflow platforms.
- Establish and monitor performance measures such as automation rate, exception volume, posting accuracy, manual effort, and improvement delivery.
- Lead change management and continuous-improvement routines that build sustainable adoption, documentation, accountability, and cross-functional alignment.

Qualifications
We would expect the successful candidate to have:
- We expect at least 5 years of experience leading projects or programs within Finance Operations, Accounting, cash application, accounts receivable, payments, or a related domain.
- Proven experience leading automation, system implementation, finance transformation, or process redesign initiatives from requirements through deployment and stabilization.
- Experience designing or improving rule-based workflows, advanced matching solutions, AI-enabled processes, or exception-management frameworks.
- Strong analytical skills and practical experience with SQL, Python, Power BI, or comparable data and reporting tools.
- Understanding of financial controls, audit requirements, data governance, process accuracy, and the risks associated with payment and posting workflows.
- Ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into scalable automation strategies, roadmaps, requirements, and prioritized backlogs.
- Strong problem-solving, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills across Finance, Accounting, Technology, Data, and client-facing teams.
- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, including Excel and PowerPoint.
- Experience with ERP systems and payment or banking platforms.
- Familiarity with data integration, APIs, modern automation concepts, testing, and implementation practices.
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Yardi or another ERP supporting real estate receivables and cash application.
- Experience in real estate, a REIT, or another complex multi-entity environment.
- Demonstrated ownership of customer payment channels, banking instruction controls, remittance processing, and cash application performance.
- Experience applying AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, or confidence-based matching to finance operations.
- Experience developing business cases and evaluating vendors or technology platforms for finance transformation.
